common.compareNotice: Latest version loaded; your form changes are kept. Compare before submitting again.
common.leaveUncertain: A submission is not confirmed yet and may be hard to check after leaving. Leave anyway?
common.leaveUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
common.uncertain: The result is not confirmed yet. To avoid a duplicate, only the original request can be retried and the form stays locked.

errors.network: The connection failed or timed out. Valid input is kept; please try again.
errors.timeout: The service took too long to respond. Please try again.
errors.incompatible: The service response could not be read. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.unavailable: The service or a required dependency is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.module_unavailable: The service behind this feature is not enabled or not available.
errors.identity: The identity service is not connected or temporarily unavailable.
errors.unauthenticated: Please sign in first. Input on this page is kept.
errors.forbidden: This account does not meet the permission or eligibility for this action.
errors.not_found: The content does not exist, was removed or is not visible now.
errors.conflict: The content changed or the request conflicts. Refresh and check.
errors.invalid_input: Check the required fields and their format.
errors.invalid: The submitted values are invalid. Check your input.
errors.capacity_exceeded: The content exceeds the allowed size or count.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts or the limit is reached. Please try again later.
errors.retry_required: The previous submission is not confirmed. Retry the original request first.
errors.edit_window_closed: The editing window has closed. This action is unavailable.
errors.enrollment_required: No enrollment record was found for you in this course and semester. You cannot submit a review yet.
errors.disclosure_required: Authorized real name or teacher verification is missing. You cannot reply to your own course yet.
errors.identity_owned: This student identity belongs to another account. Recover that account or contact an administrator.
errors.expired: The application, code or capture link expired. Please start again.
errors.information_mismatch: The information did not match. Check it or choose another available method.
errors.method_unavailable: This method is unavailable. Choose another available method.
errors.processing: The request is still processing. Refresh or retry shortly.
errors.school_mismatch: The school in the file differs from the selected school.
errors.qq_binding_forbidden: This account cannot manage QQ bindings.
errors.qq_binding_not_found: No QQ binding was found for this account.
errors.qq_binding_revision_conflict: The binding changed in the meantime. Look it up again before acting.
errors.qq_binding_rate_limited: Too many requests. Try again later.
errors.qq_binding_unavailable: The QQ binding service is unavailable.
errors.billing_not_found: No matching billing record was found.
errors.billing_unavailable: The billing service is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.billing_closure_conflict: The data changed in the meantime, or the account is being closed. Refresh and try again.
errors.billing_insufficient_funds: The balance is too low for this action.
errors.billing_assets_pending: The account still has assets being processed. Try again later.
errors.billing_operation_too_large: This operation covers too much data at once.
errors.billing_conflict: The data changed in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
errors.invalid_request: The request format is not valid. Check it and try again.

framework.title: Administration
framework.description: See the state of platform modules and open each management area from the menu.

errors.forbidden: This account cannot access the administration workspace.
errors.identity: Administrator identity service is not connected yet.
errors.network: Unable to connect to the administration service. Please try again later.
errors.unauthenticated: Sign in to access the administration workspace.
errors.incompatible: This service version is incompatible. Refresh the page and try again.

overview.moderation: Handle pending content, reports and author requests.
overview.catalog: Correct course and teacher records and import academic data.
overview.resources: Review resources and manage visibility, access grants, categories and folders.
overview.verification: Review verification materials, removal requests and school settings.
overview.storage: View storage instances, custody requests and storage contributions.

notFound.description: The address may be incorrect, or the feature is not available yet.

moderation.queueIntro: Handle reviews, reports and author requests within your authorized schools.
moderation.contentIntro: Browse course reviews, mentor comments and replies by state and act on a single entry.
moderation.policyIntro: Set the publication mode and blocked terms per content kind. School rules override the global default; saving checks the revision so another administrator’s change is not overwritten.
moderation.presentationIntro: Set review preview limits for guests and signed-in users, and the five-level rating wording per language.
moderation.empty: Nothing to handle for these filters.
moderation.author: Author identity
moderation.signedIdentity: Show with the platform nickname (clear for anonymous)
moderation.attributionUnavailable: The attribution cannot be checked right now.
moderation.batchHint: Selected: {count} (up to 20). Preview each item before submitting the batch.
moderation.blockedTermsHint: Content matching a blocked term is held or reviewed according to the mode. Duplicates are merged.

actionHint.publish: The content passes review and becomes public.
actionHint.hide: Hidden from public pages; data is kept and can be restored.
actionHint.restore: Restores public display and informs the people involved.
actionHint.delete: Moderation deletion; records are kept and it can still be restored.
actionHint.edit: Saves an edit note; authorship is unchanged and the author’s text stays distinguishable.
actionHint.identity: Identity changes apply to this author across the discussion and use only the public nickname.
actionHint.dismiss: Closes this request or report without changing the content.
actionHint.feature: Marks the entry as featured; rewards are handled by the billing module.
actionHint.unfeature: Removes the featured mark; state the reason in the note.
actionHint.reassign: Corrects the teacher attribution from the latest trusted enrollment; check before saving.

catalog.title: Course and teacher records
catalog.intro: Correct basic information while preserving source and history. Later imports retain manual corrections.
catalog.name: Name
catalog.creditsHint: Keep unknown credits as not provided; zero credits means something else.
catalog.savedValues: The server now has the name “{name}”. Your input is kept; review it and save again.
catalog.mergeHint: Confirm both records refer to the same object. Target details are kept; the source name becomes an alias. Other source fields do not overwrite the target. Existing links and history remain.
catalog.merged: Merged. Old links and history are preserved.
catalog.importIntro: Read a normalized catalog file, preview new, updated, conflicting and unlinked records, then confirm. Manual corrections are kept and a failed import never clears existing data.
catalog.importFileHint: The file is read in the browser, up to 4 MB, and must match the selected school.
catalog.schoolMismatch: The school in the file differs from the selected school.
catalog.previewInvalid: The preview did not pass; fix the file and try again.
catalog.imported: Import complete: catalog objects {objects}, enrollments {enrollments}, manual corrections kept {preserved}.

resources.manageIntro: View resources in your scope, publish, unlist or block them, and grant or revoke access for specific users.
resources.reviewIntro: Review first uploads, corrections and new file versions. Published versions stay available during review.
resources.title: Title
resources.stateHint: Unlisting stops new access while existing buyers can still download; blocking stops all downloads.
resources.subjectKeyHint: Use the stable user identifier from the identity service, not a phone or student number.
resources.revokeConfirm: Revoke this grant? Other access sources are not affected.
resources.categoriesIntro: Categories and their fields drive filtering and grouping. Stable identifiers survive renaming.
resources.directoriesIntro: Organise multi-level folders by school and course. Uploaders can only suggest a folder.

verification.title: Verification administration
verification.intro: Review materials, manage eligibility changes and configure verification by school.
verification.noAccess: This account cannot manage student verification.
verification.name: Full name
verification.expiryOverrideHint: Leave empty to use the school’s opening date and newcomer days.
verification.openingDateHint: A calendar date in Beijing time.

methods.student_email_outbound_otp: Receive a code at school email

profileStatus.partial: Partial data; missing fields are not inferred
profileStatus.reference_only: Data belongs to the separately imported academic source; only the link is stored here
profileStatus.unavailable: No profile data is currently available

storage.title: Storage operations
storage.description: Review storage instances, capacity, replicas and jobs, and manage them with current permissions.
storage.quotaHint: Enter an integer at least equal to used plus reserved capacity.
storage.confirmHint: The server will check current permissions and state again.
storage.revokeHint: Revocation stops use of this instance. Restoring access requires account authorization verification.

reasons.writes_disabled: This instance is not accepting new files.

contribution.title: Storage contribution management
contribution.intro: Review contribution status, capacity and migration progress. Retry blocked tasks.
contribution.accepted: Request accepted; storage confirmation is pending. Refresh to check the actual state.
contribution.adminHint: Retry preserves the user’s quota, term, consent and requested state.
contribution.confirmRetry: Confirm retry of the original request
contribution.unknown: Status unavailable. Refresh or contact an administrator.

reasons.storage_conflict: Storage state conflict. Refresh and review.
reasons.binding_unavailable: Storage binding unavailable; administrator review required.
reasons.storage_writes_disabled: Storage is not accepting new files.
reasons.exit_overdue: Exit target passed; migration is still pending.

custody.title: Storage custody
custody.intro: Review custody requests and resume existing operations. Administrators cannot consent for users or read passwords.
custody.uncertain: The operation result is uncertain. Resume the original request with the same consent and conditions.

reasons.authorization_rejected: Authorization was rejected. Check credentials or verification requirements.
reasons.dependency_unavailable: The provider or a required service is unavailable.
reasons.result_unknown: The remote result is unknown. Only the original dedicated folder may be reconciled.
reasons.conflict: The account is already registered or the record changed. Refresh and review.
reasons.attempts_exhausted: The retry limit was reached. Administrator action is required.
reasons.credentials_required: No recoverable credential was saved. Submit credentials again.

openPlatform.title: Open platform app review
openPlatform.intro: Review third-party apps submitted by developers. Approval sets the scopes and limits that apply; users still consent to each scope.
openPlatform.name: App

decisionHint.approve: The app can ask users for the selected scopes. Approving a suspended app again does not restore earlier user grants.
decisionHint.changes_requested: The developer sees the note and resubmits after changes.
decisionHint.suspend: Suspends the app at once and revokes every user grant; old tokens stop working.

openPlatform.noteRequired: Review note (required, visible to the developer)
openPlatform.noteOptional: Review note (optional, visible to the developer)

reviewed.changes_requested: Changes were requested from the developer.
reviewed.suspended: The app is suspended and user grants were revoked.

scopes.qq_binding_details: QQ binding status and QQ number

qqBinding.title: QQ binding
qqBinding.intro: Look up the three QQ binding parts of an account and release one when needed. Each lookup is audited.
qqBinding.ownerHint: Enter the server account key (encoded issuer and user ID); copy it from the account’s records.
qqBinding.releaseHint: The account’s QQ binding becomes incomplete at once; the other two parts are kept. The user can bind again.

teacherVerification.title: Teacher verification
teacherVerification.intro: Review proof of teaching per school and link the applicant to teacher profiles in the course catalog, or look up and revoke a teacher qualification. Teacher verification is separate from student verification.
teacherVerification.empty: No teacher applications are waiting for review.
teacherVerification.revokeHint: Revoking ends the qualification at once and unlinks the teacher profiles. The record is kept.
teacherVerification.profilesHint: Only teacher profiles of this school can be chosen. Choose at least one to approve.
teacherVerification.expiryHint: Leave empty to keep it valid until revoked.
teacherVerification.noteHint: Required to ask for more materials or to reject. The applicant sees this note.

done.supplement: The application was returned for more materials.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.intro: Review top-up refunds. An approved refund goes back through the original payment channel or to manual payout; record the real result of each manual payout.
refunds.manualHint: Use this when the original channel cannot return the money. The user enters payout details, then an administrator pays and records the result.
refunds.reasonHint: Required to reject. The user sees this note.
refunds.manualIntro: Record the result after the payout was made. A success completes the refund; a failure returns the amount to the user’s balance.

done.paid: The payout was recorded as paid.
done.payoutFailed: The payout was recorded as failed.
done.recorded: The result of the action was confirmed.

refunds.paymentChannelHint: Enter the channel and paying account actually used, for example “Bank A corporate account”. A transaction number can be recorded only once per channel.

accounts.title: Account billing
accounts.intro: Look up an account’s balance, orders and ledger; refund points purchases, grant rewards and revoke them. Every lookup is audited.
accounts.subjectHint: Copy the issuer and user ID from the account’s records.
accounts.frozen: This account’s assets are frozen. The user cannot spend or withdraw for now.
accounts.refundSummary: Refund this points purchase: {amount}. The Ivory returns to the user’s balance and the points are deducted.
accounts.recorded: The result of the action was confirmed.
accounts.objectHint: This rule counts per item. Enter the ID of the content that earned the reward.
accounts.eventHint: Each event ID is granted once; sending it again returns the first result.
accounts.revokeHint: Revoking takes back the points granted for the event. Missing points are recorded as points owed.

rewardState.disabled: The rule is disabled, so no points were granted.
rewardState.limit_reached: The rule’s limit was reached, so no points were granted.
rewardState.expired: The event is outside the rule’s validity, so no points were granted.

config.title: Billing settings
config.intro: Manage top-up channels, points offers and reward rules, including disabled ones. Offers and rules have versions; a save is rejected when someone else changed the item meanwhile.
config.idHint: Letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens only. It cannot change after saving.
config.amountsHint: In yuan, separated by commas, for example 10, 30, 50.
config.originalRefundsHint: When off, every refund for this channel goes to manual payout.
config.priceHint: In yuan, up to two decimals.
config.limitHint: How many times one account can earn it within a period.
config.perObjectHint: When on, the limit applies separately to each item.
config.ruleNotice: A rule takes effect as soon as it is saved. Rewards already granted are not changed.

review.intro: Automatic queries ran out and the channel result is still unknown. Schedule one more query, or record the result after checking with the channel.
review.evidenceHint: Enter a traceable reference such as a channel ticket or statement number. Do not paste payment payloads.
review.title: Review payment result

access.title: Roles
access.intro: Grant administrators roles within a school, group and module scope. Platform administrators hold every capability automatically; other administrators hold only what is granted. Every grant and revocation needs a reason and is recorded.
access.subject: Administrator ID
access.subjectHint: Enter the administrator’s user ID (subject) in the identity service.
access.platformAdmin: This account is a platform administrator and holds every capability in every scope; no role is needed.
access.noGrants: No roles are granted to this administrator.
access.roleIdHint: Enter the ID of the role to grant; see the templates or roles created below.
access.scopeHint: “*” covers the whole dimension; all three dimensions must match.
access.templatesHint: Templates are starting points and grant nothing by themselves. Roles cannot change after creation; create a new role to adjust capabilities.
access.newRoleIdHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens, starting with a letter. It cannot change later.
access.capabilitiesHint: Type a capability ID and press Enter, for example billing.manage.

audit.title: Operation log
audit.intro: Administration records from every module you may read, merged by time. When a module cannot be queried, the page lists the missing records.
audit.partial: These modules could not be queried, so the results are incomplete: {modules}

lookup.title: Information lookup
lookup.intro: Find records linked to a person across business modules by name, student number, QQ number or account ID. The server checks each domain, scope and sensitive field against your current grants and records every query before returning results.
lookup.sensitiveHint: Leave all unchecked to receive masked identity fields only. Each checked category needs its own grant; without it the whole query is refused.
lookup.purposeHint: Explain why the information is needed, such as the ticket or appeal number. The purpose is recorded with the query.
lookup.incomplete: These domains are not connected yet, so the results are incomplete: {domains}
lookup.empty: No records match that you are allowed to see.
lookup.auditPurposeHint: Explain why you need to view the query log. Viewing it is also recorded.

timetable.title: Class periods
timetable.intro: Set the Monday of week one, the school time zone and the start and end of each period for a term. Student timetables and calendar exports use these to turn period numbers into times; a term without them cannot be exported.
timetable.missing: No periods are set for this term yet. Students can export calendars once they are saved.
timetable.weekOneHint: Choose the Monday of the first teaching week.
timetable.timezoneHint: An IANA time zone name, such as Asia/Shanghai.

problems.notMonday: Week one must start on a Monday.
problems.timezone: The time zone name is not recognized.
problems.periodTime: Each period must end after it starts, within the same day.
problems.periodOrder: Periods must be in order and must not overlap.
